package appsaccounts

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/z-chenhao/assistant/internal/plugin/appsaccounts/contract"
	"github.com/z-chenhao/assistant/pkg/rsiplugin"
)

func Handlers() rsiplugin.Handlers {
	return rsiplugin.Handlers{PluginID: "steward.apps-accounts", Version: "1.0.0", Services: map[string]func(context.Context, rsiplugin.Call) (rsiplugin.Result, error){contract.ConnectIntent: connectIntent, contract.AuthConfig: authConfig, contract.SessionFlow: sessionFlow}}
}
func connectIntent(ctx context.Context, call rsiplugin.Call) (rsiplugin.Result, error) {
	var request contract.ConnectRequest
	if err := rsiplugin.Decode(call.Input, &request); err != nil {
		return rsiplugin.Result{}, err
	}
	if len(call.Inputs) != 1 || call.Inputs[0].ID != contract.ConnectInputID {
		return rsiplugin.Result{}, errors.New("invalid connection input")
	}
	var raw bytes.Buffer
	if err := rsiplugin.ReadInputTo(ctx, call.Inputs[0], &raw); err != nil {
		return rsiplugin.Result{}, err
	}
	rows, err := contract.DecodeConnectRows(raw.Bytes(), request.Count)
	if err != nil {
		return rsiplugin.Result{}, err
	}
	return rsiplugin.JSONResult(ctx, chooseConnect(rows, request.Alias))
}
func chooseConnect(rows []contract.ConnectRow, alias string) contract.ConnectPlan {
	if alias == "" {
		for _, row := range rows {
			if row.Facts&contract.Active != 0 && row.Facts&contract.Public == 0 {
				return contract.ConnectPlan{Kind: "alias_required"}
			}
		}
		for i := len(rows) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
			if rows[i].Facts&contract.Pending != 0 {
				row := i
				return contract.ConnectPlan{Kind: "pending", Row: &row}
			}
		}
		alias = "personal"
		for _, row := range rows {
			if row.Alias == alias {
				alias = "personal_" + uuid.NewString()[:8]
			}
		}
	}
	for i, row := range rows {
		if row.Alias == alias && row.Facts&contract.Disconnected == 0 {
			if row.Facts&contract.Pending != 0 {
				value := i
				return contract.ConnectPlan{Kind: "pending", Row: &value}
			}
			return contract.ConnectPlan{Kind: "conflict"}
		}
	}
	return contract.ConnectPlan{Kind: "new", Alias: alias}
}
